nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_water.descrip: Demon Water Magic is a sinister form of water: ink-black tides lit with teal-green light that drown, crush and push, and also wash wounds closed. Its pages are a tidal push and a dark wave for starters, a drowning grasp, a healing mist, a serpent dash and a ward of the deep, the Abyssal Whirlpool as a zone, the Hydra of Darkneros as its signature, and Tide Rebirth once in a long while. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_demon_water.description: The grimoire of Demon Water Magic: corrupted water that drowns, slows and crushes foes and heals friends. Its eleven pages range from the Tidal Push to the Hydra of Darkneros, whose spiked serpents hunt down enemies, and Tide Rebirth, which cleanses and mends. Damage, radius and healing grow with your existence points, and some pages strike the spirit directly. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.demon_water_: The first tide a Demon Water mage learns: a dark wave thrown ahead like a spear. It flies 22 blocks and pierces everything in its path for 8 damage, scaled by existence points.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.tidal_push: The black water rises in front of the caster and shoves everything back. A cone of 9 blocks deals 6 damage, throws foes away and a little up, and slows them (Slowness III) for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.dark_tide_wa: A flat wall of dark water runs down the hall like a flood. A 16-block line, 2.2 blocks wide, deals 9 damage, shoves foes along, slows them for 2.5 seconds and strikes 3 spiritual health, which ignores armour (not on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.drowning_gra: Water gathers inside the target's lungs and does not leave. For up to 4 seconds (shorter on players and bosses) the target is crawling (Slowness V) and weakened, loses its air, and takes 3 damage every half second plus 1 spiritual damage. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.healing_mist: Not all of the dark water is cruel. A cool teal mist spreads 8 blocks around the caster and closes wounds: you and your allies are healed 15 percent of max health, gain Regeneration II for 5 seconds, and lose poison, slowness and fire.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.serpent_surg: The caster becomes a serpent of the deep and darts through the air. A dash of up to 9 blocks hits everything on the path for 6 damage with a push and a 2 second slow, then grants Water Breathing for 20 seconds and Dolphin's Grace for 6 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.abyssal_ward: A shell of pressure from the deep sea wraps the body. For 12 seconds you have Resistance II and Water Breathing, your melee hits deal 4 extra damage, and attackers are lashed back for 2 damage.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.abyssal_whir: A black whirlpool opens at the point you look at, 5 blocks wide, and does not let go. For 5 seconds it drags everything toward its centre, slows it (Slowness III), and tears at it for 3 damage every second. Bosses are pulled only a little.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.hydra_of_dar: The caster raises a great sphere of water, and from its surface eyeless, spiked serpents rise to crush the target in their sharp-toothed mouths. 3 to 5 serpents (by existence points) leave the sphere one after another and hunt the nearest enemies: each hit deals 7 damage, 3 spiritual damage, Slowness III and Weakness II, and drains the target's air. The serpents live about 1.2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.tide_rebirth: The water that took so much gives back. You and allies within 6 blocks lose every harmful effect and are healed (50 percent of max health for you, 25 percent for allies), with Absorption II for 30 seconds and Regeneration II for 10 seconds. Cooldown 10 minutes.
